affected_party: QIF evaluators, accountable reviewers, domain specialists, affected stakeholders, and governance owners
actual_problem: QIF records a routed review outcome but cannot yet preserve independent reviewer judgments, exact reasons for disagreement, overrides, or adjudication without collapsing them into one result.
why_it_matters: Majority vote or seniority can hide a valid dissent, unclear rubric, evidence conflict, role boundary, or stakeholder loss boundary and create false confidence in a final verdict.
why_now: v0.6.36 completes escalation resolution, while current evaluation research shows human-AI and inter-agent agreement varies by criterion and emerging systems use disagreement as a targeted human-review signal rather than noise.
